# descope_company_splunk_connector (Resource)

Manages a company-level Splunk connector that streams the audit events of the whole company. It requires a company management key, and a company can have only one company-level connector.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hec_token` (String, Sensitive) An HTTP Event Collector token configured on your Splunk project.
- `hec_url` (String) The URL to be used accessing your Splunk system, including the appropriate port
- `name` (String) A custom name for your connector.

### Optional

- `audit_enabled` (Boolean) Whether to enable streaming of audit events.
- `description` (String) A description of what your connector is used for.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the connector is disabled. This can be used to temporarily stop a connector from executing without fully deleting it.
- `index` (String) An optional index to use for all sent events

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
